note: Beulah Park District park on the south bank of the Knife River, off ND 49 on the north edge of town, beside the high school football field, with playgrounds, picnic shelters, a gazebo, disc golf and horseshoes. Not the separate Beulah Bay on Lake Sakakawea. --Claude
summary: Beulah Park District pages read: 8 bookable 'Electric Only' sites (water false), $25 paid in full, primitive $10 by permit, 7-day limit, back-in, showers, dump. Not waterfront stands (the Knife River here is ~10-15 m wide: creekside at most, behind trees). Phone -> office (701) 873-5852 suggested. LEAD: Eagles Campground (Beulah Park District, across Hwy 49), closed for 2026, not in the DB.
flags: HOOKUPS: water false is new. Each of Sites 1-8 on the booking list says 'Electric Only'; amperage not posted.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. The Knife River beside the park is ~10-15 m wide (zoom-19 tile at 47.2543,-101.7840), so creekside is the most it could be. Map sites 5-8 sit on the west road about 15-25 m from the channel, but behind a continuous band of riverside trees. Sites 1-4 are by the football field, well away from the water. No change.
PHONE: stored 701-870-0602 is the page's after-8 p.m. check-in line. The Park District office on every page is (701) 873-5852 (fax 873-5853). Suggest 701-870-0602 -> (701) 873-5852, or keep both.

LEAD: Eagles Campground, Beulah (Beulah Park District; 'Located on Hwy 49 across from Riverside Park'; about 47.256,-101.788 on imagery, the row of pads west of ND 49 north of the river). 'CLOSED FOR THE 2026 SEASON'. '10 electrical sites only with water. Dumping station on site', May-October, $25/day, $140/week, $420/month. Not in campgrounds.json; not vetted. With a weekly and monthly rate and a 2026 closure, it may not qualify.
